tool_args.rationale: The verified barrier-siphon mechanism matches the activation and sink-gradient signatures. Fit its four parameters numerically to the five paid observations and use fresh confirmation to test generalization.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed s_grad span is 2.0, well above the mechanism note's 0.08 threshold; the five observations constrain the four-parameter model.
Neither includes the sink-gradient dependence indicated by the pilot signatures and verified mechanism note.
The proposed mechanism is algebraic and the pilot is already at the target horizon, so a trajectory batch is not needed for identification.
